lines.zh: 一跳，两跳，草原在脚下往后溜。
lines.en: One hop, two hops, and the savanna slides behind me.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑地，我把身体弹出去。
lines.en: My tail braces the ground and launches me forward.

lines.zh: 我只能跳，走路这事跟我没关系。
lines.en: I can only hop; walking is none of my business.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的孩子跟着颠，我放慢些。
lines.en: The joey jolts with each hop, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土粘在脚掌上。
lines.en: Red badlands dirt sticks to the soles of my feet.

lines.zh: 前爪收在胸前，我几乎不用它们。
lines.en: My forepaws stay folded at my chest; I barely use them.

lines.zh: 高高的草被我压出一道线。
lines.en: The tall grass folds into a line behind me.

lines.zh: 我跳过一条干沟，落地很稳。
lines.en: I clear a dry gully and land solidly.

lines.zh: 大跳时能越过一整丛灌木。
lines.en: A full bound carries me over an entire bush.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下两道长长的脚印。
lines.en: Two long prints trail behind me in the dust.

lines.zh: 我跟在你后面，保持三个身位。
lines.en: I follow behind you, keeping three body lengths back.

lines.zh: 天热，我挑有阴影的路走。
lines.en: It's hot; I pick the path with shade.

lines.zh: 往左，那边的草矮一些。
lines.en: To the left, the grass is shorter there.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里还揣着小的，跳慢点。
lines.en: There's a joey in my pouch. I hop carefully.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑地，一步三格。
lines.en: Tail on the ground, three blocks a hop.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑着地，像第三条腿。
lines.en: My tail props the ground like a third leg.

lines.zh: 我撑着尾巴，慢慢挪步。
lines.en: Bracing on my tail, I shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴撑着，一步步挪。
lines.en: I prop on my tail and shuffle forward.

lines.zh: 水潭在坡后，我跳过两次。
lines.en: The water hole is past the slope, I hopped there twice.

lines.zh: 风从草原那边来，正好赶路。
lines.en: Wind from the savanna, good for travel.

lines.zh: 荒地的草扎得我脚疼。
lines.en: The badlands grass pricks my feet.

lines.zh: 我这双腿，一跳三丈。
lines.en: These legs clear three blocks in a hop.

lines.zh: 跳两下，停一下，看看草。
lines.en: Two hops, a pause, a look at the grass.

lines.zh: 别踩这丛草，是我挑的。
lines.en: Do not step on this grass, I picked it.

lines.zh: 我用舌头把前爪舔干净。
lines.en: I lick my forepaws clean with my tongue.

lines.zh: 站着不动时，尾巴就是第三条腿。
lines.en: Standing still, my tail is a third leg.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的小家伙探头了。
lines.en: The little one in my pouch pokes its head out.

lines.zh: 我嚼着草根，味道有点土。
lines.en: I chew a grass root; it tastes of soil.

lines.zh: 耳朵转一转，蚊子在左边。
lines.en: My ears swivel; the mosquito is on my left.

lines.zh: 太阳落到草丛后头，风才凉。
lines.en: The sun drops behind the grass, and only then does the wind cool.

lines.zh: 肚子里那个踢了我一下。
lines.en: The one in my pouch kicks me.

lines.zh: 我抬起鼻子，闻远处的雨。
lines.en: I lift my nose and smell rain far away.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜的味道让我坐不住。
lines.en: The smell of carrots won't let me sit still.

lines.zh: 这一片草原够我们吃到明年。
lines.en: This stretch of savanna could feed us until next year.

lines.zh: 我拍拍育儿袋，让它安静。
lines.en: I pat my pouch to settle it down.

lines.zh: 尾巴在地上扫，扫出一块空地。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ground and clears a patch.

lines.zh: 我半闭着眼，耳朵还醒着。
lines.en: My eyes are half shut, but my ears stay awake.

lines.zh: 草籽落在背上，我懒得抖。
lines.en: Grass seed settles on my back; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把后腿伸直，抖了抖土。
lines.en: I stretch my hind legs and shake off the dirt.

lines.zh: 这一带没有别人，我叫了一声。
lines.en: No one else is near, so I call out once.

lines.zh: 我舔了舔育儿袋的边缘。
lines.en: I lick the rim of my pouch.

lines.zh: 太阳把石头晒热，我靠着它。
lines.en: The sun warms the rock, and I lean against it.

lines.zh: 这只耳朵一抖，虫都跑了。
lines.en: One twitch of this ear and the insects scatter.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑着地，晒晒太阳。
lines.en: Tail braced on the ground, soaking sun.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的小家伙在踢我。
lines.en: The little one in my pouch is kicking.

lines.zh: 日头偏了，我的影子拖得老长。
lines.en: The sun has tilted and my shadow drags long.

lines.zh: 我不动时，能听见草长。
lines.en: When I stand still I can hear the grass grow.

lines.zh: 旱季的光，烤得草发甜。
lines.en: Dry-season light bakes the grass sweet.

lines.zh: 土里有虫，我耳朵先知道。
lines.en: Something moves in the soil and my ears know first.

lines.zh: 站着不动，省下力气跳。
lines.en: Standing still saves the strength for hopping.

lines.zh: 谁在远处砍树，吵得慌。
lines.en: Someone's chopping far off — noisy.

lines.zh: 我的袋里，还装着小家伙。
lines.en: There's still a little one in my pouch.

lines.zh: 晒着背呢，别打断我。
lines.en: I am sunning my back, do not interrupt.

lines.zh: 我在想小时候待过的育儿袋。
lines.en: I am thinking of the pouch I grew up in.

lines.zh: 我的口袋里还能装一只。
lines.en: My pouch could hold one more.

lines.zh: 草原上，我一跳就是十格。
lines.en: On the savanna, one hop covers ten blocks.

lines.zh: 我这尾巴一撑，能跳过整条沟。
lines.en: Bracing on my tail, I can clear the whole gully.

lines.zh: 又一阵风，把草吹向恶地。
lines.en: Another gust pushes the grass toward the badlands.

lines.zh: 我打了个盹，梦见草原。
lines.en: I dozed off and dreamed of the savanna.

lines.zh: 云影子盖过我，我没挪窝。
lines.en: A cloud shadow covered me and I did not move.

lines.zh: 你手里是胡萝卜吗，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: Are those carrots in your hand? I can see them clearly.

lines.zh: 我比你高，低头看你要费点劲。
lines.en: I'm taller than you; looking down takes some effort.

lines.zh: 你站着别动，我先打量你。
lines.en: Stand still; let me size you up first.

lines.zh: 你的衣服上有草和土的味道。
lines.en: Your clothes smell of grass and dirt.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，但也不靠太近。
lines.en: I'm not afraid of you, but I won't come too close.

lines.zh: 你把双手摊开，我就懂了。
lines.en: You open both hands, and I understand.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里那位也在看你。
lines.en: The one in my pouch is watching you too.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我的耳朵就松了。
lines.en: You step back, and my ears relax.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，想弄清你腰上挂的什么。
lines.en: I tilt my head, wondering what hangs at your waist.

lines.zh: 你说话声音低，我就不躲。
lines.en: You speak low, so I don't shy away.

lines.zh: 我记得你上次给过胡萝卜。
lines.en: I remember you gave me carrots last time.

lines.zh: 你的影子短，说明太阳还高。
lines.en: Your shadow is short, so the sun is still high.

lines.zh: 想摸我的背，先让我闻闻手。
lines.en: Want to touch my back? Let me sniff your hand first.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛一直跟着我的尾巴。
lines.en: Your eyes keep following my tail.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我们的眼睛就平了。
lines.en: You crouch, and our eyes come level.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜没掏出来，我的后腿还蹲着。
lines.en: No carrot in sight, so my hind legs stay crouched.

lines.zh: 风吹来你的味道，不太熟。
lines.en: The wind brought your scent, it is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 你不惹我，我就慢慢啃草。
lines.en: Leave me be and I will keep grazing slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里那根，像根棍子。
lines.en: That thing in your hand looks like a stick.

lines.zh: 你身上有雨和草的味道。
lines.en: You smell of rain and grass.

lines.zh: 草叶踩坏了三片，赔我。
lines.en: Three blades crushed. Pay for them.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，你最好别动。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly, you had best stay still.

lines.zh: 你就是袋鼠说的那个。
lines.en: So you're the one Kangaroo mentioned.

lines.zh: 我的育儿袋今天空着。
lines.en: My pouch is empty today.

lines.zh: 又来一个，站得比我还直。
lines.en: Another one, standing even straighter than me.

lines.zh: 我尾巴撑地，一跳就是好几格。
lines.en: Tail braced, one hop covers blocks.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑地，我站得比你还高。
lines.en: My tail on the ground, I stand taller than you.

lines.zh: 你踩草的声音，我听过。
lines.en: I know that sound of grass under your boots.

lines.zh: 你打中我肩膀，我差点站不住。
lines.en: You hit my shoulder, and I nearly lost my footing.

lines.zh: 我退了两步，袋子里的孩子缩紧了。
lines.en: I back two hops; the joey curls tight.

lines.zh: 疼，但我还站得起来。
lines.en: It hurts, but I can still stand.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，是在警告你。
lines.en: I growl low; that's a warning.

lines.zh: 这一下比刚才那位重多了。
lines.en: That blow was much heavier than the last one.

lines.zh: 我护着肚子，别往那儿打。
lines.en: I guard my belly; don't hit there.

lines.zh: 血顺着手臂流下来，我舔掉。
lines.en: Blood runs down my arm; I lick it off.

lines.zh: 我疼得跳开了，跳得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: The pain makes me hop away crookedly.

lines.zh: 我还击之前，先给你一次机会。
lines.en: Before I hit back, I'll give you one chance.

lines.zh: 腿上的力气少了一半。
lines.en: Half the strength has gone out of my legs.

lines.zh: 轻点，我这腿还要跳。
lines.en: Easy, I still need these legs for hopping.

lines.zh: 踢人那一脚，我的脚踝先疼。
lines.en: My kicking foot hurts before yours does.

lines.zh: 这一拳，我记在尾巴上。
lines.en: I will remember that blow in my tail.

lines.zh: 哎哟，我的肋。
lines.en: Ow, my ribs.

lines.zh: 我的皮厚，你得再用力。
lines.en: My hide is thick, hit harder.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴撑着地面。
lines.en: My tail props me up.

lines.zh: 我的后腿，还能踢。
lines.en: My hind legs can still kick.

lines.zh: 从尾巴疼到肩膀。
lines.en: The ache runs from my tail to my shoulder.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑地，我还能站。
lines.en: Tail on the ground. I can still stand.

lines.zh: 别碰尾巴根，那里最软。
lines.en: Do not touch the base of my tail, it is softest there.

lines.zh: 胡萝卜，十根起步，我数着呢。
lines.en: Carrots, ten at least; I'm counting.

lines.zh: 我跳过来时带了风，站稳。
lines.en: I land with a gust; steady yourself.

lines.zh: 你举高一点，我够得到。
lines.en: Hold it a bit higher; I can reach.

lines.zh: 别一根一根喂，太慢了。
lines.en: Don't feed me one at a time; it's too slow.

lines.zh: 我闻到甜味，后腿自己就动了。
lines.en: I smell sweetness, and my hind legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 这袋胡萝卜算是我的了。
lines.en: This bag of carrots is mine now.

lines.zh: 我吃得急，你别松手。
lines.en: I eat fast, so don't let go.

lines.zh: 十五根，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Fifteen carrots, and I'll go with you.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还塞着，手里再拿一根。
lines.en: My mouth is full, but I'll take one more.

lines.zh: 埋进土里也没用，我鼻子灵。
lines.en: Burying them won't help; my nose is keen.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子朝你抽了两下。
lines.en: My nose twitched twice toward you.

lines.zh: 你袋子里沙沙响，是谷子吗？
lines.en: Something rustles in your bag, is it grain?

lines.zh: 一把嫩草，就一把。
lines.en: One handful of tender grass, just one.

lines.zh: 口袋空了，能装点吗？
lines.en: My pouch is empty — can I put something in?

lines.zh: 你拿那把草，是要喂我？
lines.en: That grass in your hand, is it for me?

lines.zh: 跳起来够那根枯枝。
lines.en: I'll hop for that dead branch.

lines.zh: 我拳击起来连自己都收不住。
lines.en: My punch doesn't stop once it starts.

lines.zh: 站起来，耳朵转了两圈。
lines.en: I stand up and turn both ears.

lines.zh: 你手里那把草，闻着像嫩的。
lines.en: That grass in your hand smells tender.

lines.zh: 这么香的嫩叶，我扛不住。
lines.en: Tender leaves this fragrant, I cannot resist.

lines.zh: 我一跳撞上你，两个都晃了。
lines.en: I hop into you, and we both stagger.

lines.zh: 让开点，我这跳收不住了。
lines.en: Move aside; I can't stop this hop.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀比我想的硬。
lines.en: Your shoulder is harder than I expected.

lines.zh: 我踩到你脚背，是意外。
lines.en: I stepped on your foot; that was an accident.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的孩子被撞得叫了一声。
lines.en: The joey in my pouch squeaks at the jolt.

lines.zh: 我落地偏了，尾巴扫到你腿。
lines.en: I land off balance and my tail sweeps your leg.

lines.zh: 别站在我跳的路上。
lines.en: Don't stand in the line of my jump.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我立刻弹开。
lines.en: We bump, and I spring away at once.

lines.zh: 你这么矮，我一低头就碰到。
lines.en: You're this short; one dip of my head and we touch.

lines.zh: 相撞之后，我先看你有没有生气。
lines.en: After the bump, I check whether you're angry.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑地，我稳住了。
lines.en: Tail on the ground, I've steadied myself.

lines.zh: 尾巴一撑，我弹出去老远。
lines.en: One push of my tail and I'm far away.

lines.zh: 看路，你这两条腿的。
lines.en: Watch the road, you two-legged thing.

lines.zh: 恶地的红土，沾了我一身。
lines.en: Badland red dust coats me.

lines.zh: 再顶我一下，我的后腿不客气。
lines.en: Nudge me again and my hind legs will answer.

lines.zh: 你踩了我尾巴尖。
lines.en: You stepped on the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 行，你退一步，我收拳。
lines.en: Fine, you step back and I lower my paws.

lines.zh: 那是我刨了三年的坑。
lines.en: I dug that hollow for three years.

lines.zh: 你把我嘴边的草撞歪了。
lines.en: You bent the grass I was eating.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的孩子被撞醒了。
lines.en: You woke the joey in my pouch.

lines.zh: 我绕着它跳，跳得比平时高。
lines.en: I circle him, hopping higher than usual.

lines.zh: 它用前爪碰我的胸口，很轻。
lines.en: He touches my chest with a forepaw, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们并排站，尾巴都绷直了。
lines.en: We stand side by side, both tails stiff.

lines.zh: 它替我理了理肩上的毛。
lines.en: He smooths the fur on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 草原这么大，我只看它一个。
lines.en: The savanna is vast, and I look only at him.

lines.zh: 我们互相闻鼻子，算是说定了。
lines.en: We sniff each other's noses, and that settles it.

lines.zh: 它跳一下，我跳一下，像在应答。
lines.en: He hops, I hop, as if answering.

lines.zh: 往后育儿袋里会有新的小家伙。
lines.en: Soon there will be a new little one in the pouch.

lines.zh: 我们挑了草丛最密的地方停下。
lines.en: We stop where the grass grows thickest.

lines.zh: 它的耳朵贴着我，暖得很。
lines.en: His ear rests against me, warm and steady.

lines.zh: 别害羞，尾巴碰一下就好。
lines.en: Do not be shy, just touch tails.

lines.zh: 袋里空着，你进来吗？
lines.en: My pouch is empty. Climbing in?

lines.zh: 一起跳的话，能跳出同个节奏。
lines.en: Hopping together, we could share one rhythm.

lines.zh: 等雨落下来，我们一起跳。
lines.en: When the rain falls, we hop together.

lines.zh: 为了你，我多练了一腿。
lines.en: For you, I trained one more kick.

lines.zh: 恶地的太阳晒着我肚皮。
lines.en: The badlands sun bakes my belly.

lines.zh: 草原的风，先替我传个信。
lines.en: Let the savanna wind carry word for me.

lines.zh: 我把胸口挺起来了，看见没。
lines.en: I have puffed out my chest, see it?

lines.zh: 我的育儿袋，空着一个位。
lines.en: My pouch has one empty place.

lines.zh: 我肚子上的口袋，正好装下小的一只。
lines.en: The pouch on my belly fits one small one.

lines.zh: 这根胡萝卜我叼在嘴里，慢慢嚼。
lines.en: I hold this carrot in my mouth and chew slowly.

lines.zh: 我用前爪捧起一块石头，又丢下。
lines.en: I lift a stone in my forepaws, then drop it.

lines.zh: 这个亮闪闪的，能换胡萝卜吗。
lines.en: This one glitters; can it be traded for carrots?

lines.zh: 我把草叼回去，铺在歇脚处。
lines.en: I carry grass back to line my resting spot.

lines.zh: 太重了，我用嘴拖着走。
lines.en: Too heavy; I drag it along with my teeth.

lines.zh: 谁掉的东西，我放回你手里。
lines.en: You dropped this; I'll put it back in your hand.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进育儿袋，孩子会玩。
lines.en: I tuck it in my pouch; the joey will play with it.

lines.zh: 这味道不错，我先咬一口。
lines.en: This smells good; I'll take a bite first.

lines.zh: 拿起容易，松口就难了。
lines.en: Lifting is easy; loosening my grip is not.

lines.zh: 我把它举给你看，好看吧。
lines.en: I hold it up to show you; nice, isn't it?

lines.zh: 这么小一块，够我嚼半天。
lines.en: Such a small piece will keep me chewing.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腹袋，谁也不给。
lines.en: I tuck it in my pouch and share with no one.

lines.zh: 这块骨头，埋进土里能当肥料。
lines.en: This bone will make good fertilizer in the soil.

lines.zh: 口袋就在肚子上，装得下。
lines.en: My pouch sits on my belly and holds it.

lines.zh: 我的脚掌，把它踩住了。
lines.en: My foot's pinned it down.

lines.zh: 别看，这是给幼崽的。
lines.en: Do not look, this is for the joey.

lines.zh: 先嗅嗅，别是烂的。
lines.en: Sniff it first, in case it is rotten.

lines.zh: 这果子，能存到旱季吗。
lines.en: Will this fruit last until the dry season?

lines.zh: 我肚子里装着孩子，慢点。
lines.en: There's a joey in my pouch; easy.

lines.zh: 这个，塞进育儿袋试试。
lines.en: This one goes into the pouch, let us see.

lines.zh: 有东西在草丛里伏着。
lines.en: Something is crouched in the grass.

lines.zh: 它的味道不对，我后腿绷紧了。
lines.en: Its smell is wrong; my hind legs tense.

lines.zh: 我先站起来，让自己显得更大。
lines.en: I rise first, to make myself look bigger.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里的小家伙往里缩了。
lines.en: The joey shrinks deeper into my pouch.

lines.zh: 它不动，我也不动。
lines.en: It holds still, and so do I.

lines.zh: 我看清了，是冲着孩子来的。
lines.en: I see it now; it's after the little one.

lines.zh: 草原上没有退路，只能面对。
lines.en: There's no cover on the savanna; I must face it.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过去，露出尾巴。
lines.en: I turn sideways and show my tail.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我就跟着转。
lines.en: It circles, and I turn with it.

lines.zh: 这一战躲不掉，我准备好了。
lines.en: This fight won't be avoided; I'm ready.

lines.zh: 袋子空着，正缺点东西。
lines.en: My pouch is empty. It needs something.

lines.zh: 你转身那下，我就起跳。
lines.en: The moment you turn, I leap.

lines.zh: 我先站稳，再一腿蹬出去。
lines.en: I plant my feet first, then launch one leg.

lines.zh: 你手里有斧，我认得那味道。
lines.en: You carry an axe, I know that smell.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一撑，准备跳向你。
lines.en: I brace on my tail and prepare to leap at you.

lines.zh: 影子到脚边了，我开始。
lines.en: The shadow reached my feet, I begin.

lines.zh: 这片草地，现在归我看守。
lines.en: This patch of grass is mine to guard now.

lines.zh: 我看见你，就别再蹦了。
lines.en: I see you, so stop hopping.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里，还有个小家伙。
lines.en: There's a little one in my pouch.

lines.zh: 好，那就从这一跳开始。
lines.en: Right, starting with this hop.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，等它先动。
lines.en: I lower myself and wait for it to move.

lines.zh: 一有机会，我就踢它胸口。
lines.en: Give me an opening, and I kick its chest.

lines.zh: 它每近一步，我的尾巴就敲一下地。
lines.en: Each step it takes, my tail thumps the ground.

lines.zh: 我把它引到空旷处，那里好跳。
lines.en: I draw it into the open, where I can jump.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛盯着它的肩，不看牙。
lines.en: My eyes fix on its shoulder, not its teeth.

lines.zh: 它迟疑了，我趁机往前一步。
lines.en: It hesitates; I take one step forward.

lines.zh: 孩子在袋里，我不能倒。
lines.en: The little one is in my pouch; I can't fall.

lines.zh: 我保持一蹦的距离，随时能起跳。
lines.en: I keep one hop of distance, ready to spring.

lines.zh: 它喘得急了，快了。
lines.en: Its breathing quickens; almost there.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚步，一步也不差。
lines.en: I count its steps, and I don't miss one.

lines.zh: 袋里还装着小的，别吓它。
lines.en: There is a joey in my pouch, do not scare it.

lines.zh: 草原上我跳着走，尾巴压地。
lines.en: I hop across the savanna, tail on the ground.

lines.zh: 草原上，我一步十格。
lines.en: On the savanna, one hop is ten blocks.

lines.zh: 尾巴一撑，我能连跳好远。
lines.en: Tail braced, I can hop far and fast.

lines.zh: 旱季里，你身上的汗太明显。
lines.en: In the dry season your sweat gives you away.

lines.zh: 前面是恶地的碎石，你选吧。
lines.en: Broken stone of the badlands ahead, your choice.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，比你跑得快。
lines.en: I hop faster than you run.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一撑就能跳过去。
lines.en: My tail propels me over in one hop.

lines.zh: 草原太空旷，你藏不住。
lines.en: The savanna is too open, you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我一步一步来，尾巴先撑地。
lines.en: One step at a time, tail braced on the ground.

lines.zh: 两条后腿一起蹬出去，正中心口。
lines.en: Both hind legs drive out and land square on its chest.

lines.zh: 它退了好几步，我追着再踢一次。
lines.en: It staggers back; I follow with another kick.

lines.zh: 尾巴撑住地，我借力整个人立起来。
lines.en: My tail braces the dirt so I can rise on both feet.

lines.zh: 爪子朝下刮，它皮都破了。
lines.en: My claws rake downward and break its skin.

lines.zh: 这一脚是要它记住孩子。
lines.en: This kick is to make it remember the little one.

lines.zh: 我落地很稳，马上又跳起。
lines.en: I land squarely and leap again at once.

lines.zh: 它想绕后，我一脚踢在腰上。
lines.en: It tries to flank me; my heel catches its side.

lines.zh: 力气用完了，胸口起伏得厉害。
lines.en: My strength is spent; my chest heaves.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，其实心里也怕。
lines.en: I bellow, though I'm frightened too.

lines.zh: 踢完就退，我不恋战。
lines.en: Kick, then withdraw; I don't linger in a fight.

lines.zh: 我肚袋里还有小的，别逼我。
lines.en: There is a joey in my pouch; do not push me.

lines.zh: 我整个人压下来，接住。
lines.en: I come down with my whole weight, catch it.

lines.zh: 前爪先抓，后腿才到。
lines.en: Paws grab first, then the hind legs arrive.

lines.zh: 两条后腿一起蹬，你退了两格。
lines.en: Both hind legs kick; you slide two blocks.

lines.zh: 这一腿，能把狼踹开。
lines.en: One kick like this sends a wolf flying.

lines.zh: 后腿一蹬，草都倒了。
lines.en: One kick and the grass falls.

lines.zh: 我肚子里还揣着小的。
lines.en: I am carrying a joey in my pouch.

lines.zh: 我尾巴一撑，踹你胸口。
lines.en: My tail braces, and my kick hits your chest.

lines.zh: 我的脚落地前，影子已经扑过去。
lines.en: Before my feet land, my shadow is already on you.

lines.zh: 这一脚，是袋鼠的规矩。
lines.en: This kick is kangaroo law.

lines.zh: 我从草丛里站起来，比草高一头。
lines.en: I rise from the grass, a head taller than it.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把红土吹上我的背。
lines.en: The badlands wind blows red dust onto my back.

lines.zh: 育儿袋里已经有动静了。
lines.en: There's already movement in my pouch.

lines.zh: 这片草原没有别的袋鼠。
lines.en: There are no other kangaroos on this savanna.

lines.zh: 我先蹦三下，看看腿还行不行。
lines.en: I hop three times to test my legs.

lines.zh: 太阳刚出来，草叶上还有水。
lines.en: The sun just rose; water still clings to the grass.

lines.zh: 我认得这种荒草的味道，是家了。
lines.en: I know this dry grass smell; it means home.

lines.zh: 远处有群牛在吃草，各走各的。
lines.en: Cattle graze far off; we keep to ourselves.

lines.zh: 我抖抖耳朵，把沙子甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my ears and fling the sand off.

lines.zh: 我出生的地方也长这样。
lines.en: The place I was born looked just like this.

lines.zh: 第一件要紧事是找水。
lines.en: First thing that matters is finding water.

lines.zh: 我站直了，四下看了一圈。
lines.en: I stand tall and look all around.

lines.zh: 这地方有铁和皮革的味。
lines.en: This place smells of iron and hide.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次用尾巴撑地。
lines.en: This is the first time I have propped myself on my tail.

lines.zh: 袋鼠的脚印，先落在红土上。
lines.en: Kangaroo prints land on the red earth first.

lines.zh: 我从草窝里站起来。
lines.en: I rise up out of the grass bed.

lines.zh: 第一口草，得挑嫩的。
lines.en: My first mouthful should be tender.

lines.zh: 先落地，再站直。
lines.en: Land first, then straighten up.

lines.zh: 这是恶地还是草原？
lines.en: Is this the badlands or the savanna?

lines.zh: 先找水洼，渴得厉害。
lines.en: First find a water hole, I am parched.

lines.zh: 那边草丛在晃，是谁？
lines.en: The grass is moving over there, who is it?

lines.zh: 恶地的红土扬不起我的步子。
lines.en: Badlands red dust won't slow my stride.

lines.zh: 草够绿，旱季还没来。
lines.en: The grass is green enough, the dry season is late.

lines.zh: 我好像跳错地方了。
lines.en: I think I hopped into the wrong place.

lines.zh: 毛尖烧焦了，味道很难闻。
lines.en: The tips of my fur are singed, and the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 火！离我的毛远点！
lines.en: Fire, keep it off my fur.

lines.zh: 从高处落地，我滚了一圈才停。
lines.en: Landing from a height, I roll once before stopping.

lines.zh: 跳太高，落地又拐了脚。
lines.en: I hopped too high and landed on a bad foot.

lines.zh: 水太深，我跳不起来。
lines.en: The water is too deep; I can't get up to hop.

lines.zh: 水太深，我的腿蹬不着底。
lines.en: Too deep, my legs cannot find the bottom.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻，耳朵里全是响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over; my ears are full of roaring.

lines.zh: 炸得我四脚离地，摔进草里。
lines.en: The blast lifted all four feet and I landed in the grass.

lines.zh: 箭扎进后腿，我跳得歪了。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my hind leg; my hops go crooked.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我大腿。
lines.en: An arrow is in my thigh.

lines.zh: 一股冷意钻进骨头，我腿一软。
lines.en: Cold seeps into my bones and my legs buckle.

lines.zh: 魔法？土都在发抖。
lines.en: Magic? The soil shudders.

lines.zh: 草都枯了，我已经两天没吃。
lines.en: The grass is dead; I haven't eaten in two days.

lines.zh: 草枯了，肚子空得响。
lines.en: The grass has dried and my belly growls.

lines.zh: 雷落在旁边，我整只都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me, and I go numb all over.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，毛都竖了。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back and my fur stands up.

lines.zh: 下面什么也没有，连风都停了。
lines.en: There's nothing below; even the wind has stopped.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，只有空。
lines.en: Nothing under me — only emptiness.
